title: UE Recovery Operator
description: Recover interrupted Unreal work with bounded retry, durable-state inspection, explicit restart approval, and final verification.

recipes.title: Recover an interrupted Editor operation
recipes.description: Inspect durable progress, apply at most three declared transient retries, preserve approval boundaries, and verify the final state.

inputs.name: jobId
inputs.description: Durable job whose checkpoint and bounded progress evidence must be recovered.

inputs.name: allowRestartApproval
inputs.description: Whether the operator may request, but never infer, a separate Editor restart approval.

steps.purpose: Read job, log, instance, and source-control state before deciding whether any retry is safe.
Check out every explicit Perforce target and require verified success before any Workflow asset write.
Request cancellation only when the active attempt cannot safely continue; atomic steps finish before cancellation becomes terminal.
After terminal validation, release only unchanged Perforce checkouts without submit, shelve, or changelist operations.
Read the terminal job/scenario result and confirm that no completed write was replayed.

result.summary: Bounded recovery result with durable checkpoint, retry, approval, and final validation evidence.
evidence: job phase, heartbeat, last progress, and bounded log
success: checkout failure caused zero asset writes

resources.description: Transient-error classification, unresponsive Editor evidence, Perforce boundary, and final acceptance rules.
